tools.name: create_bilingual_audio
tools.description: Turn parallel sentences (language A + language B) into one alternating practice track. Each sentence is spoken by the same neural voices used on bilingualmix.com, then stitched A1→B1→A2→B2 with configurable gaps. Returns a 6-hour download URL (WAV) plus a per-sentence timeline in seconds. Use dry_ru

tools.name: align_audio
tools.description: Given two publicly reachable audio URLs (same content in two languages), transcribes both with Whisper and aligns them semantically into sentence pairs with timestamps and a similarity score. Use this when the user already has recordings rather than text. Free tier limits apply (2 runs / 20 min per

tools.name: translate_lines
tools.description: Translate a list of lines between Chinese and English, keeping order and line count. Member feature — anonymous and free accounts get an auth prompt. For free usage, pass both sides yourself to create_bilingual_audio instead.

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: Report sign-in state, plan, minutes used and remaining, and per-run limits. Free, unlimited.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Pricing tiers, minute allowances and per-run limits. Free, unlimited.
